title: Receipt-Memory Bailiff
text: Receipt-Memory Bailiff presents a flawless record of a debt and watches for the instant disbelief becomes fear. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The false receipt is stamped with a genuine regret.

defeatReward.text: Receipt-Memory Bailiff is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
